name: Mr. Underhill
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to the Ring-bearer.
Action: Add Mr. Underhill to the victory display to choose an enemy engaged with you. Until the end of the round, that enemy cannot attack you.
flavor: "I will give you a travelling name now. When you go, go as Mr. Underhill." -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Tireless Ranger
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 [defense] and gains the Ranger trait.

name: Skilled Healer
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +2 hit points and gains the Healer trait.

name: Valiant Warrior
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 [attack] and gains the Warrior trait.

name: Noble Hero
text:
Permanent.
Setup: Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gets +1 [willpower] and gains the Noble trait.

name: Gildor Inglorion
text:
The first player gains control of Gildor Inglorion.
Forced: At the end of the round, discard Gildor Inglorion. The first player may spend 1 [fellowship] resource to cancel this effect.
flavor: "We think you had best come now with us." -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: Gandalf's Delay
text:
Setup: Add Gandalf's Delay to the staging area.
Each player draws 1 less card in his starting hand.

name: The Ring Draws Them
text:
Surge.
When Revealed: At the end of the phase, each enemy in the staging area engages the first player. If The One Ring is exhausted, this effect cannot be canceled.
flavor: "Also," he added, and his voice sank to a whisper, "the Ring draws them." -The Fellowship of the Ring

name: A Shadow of the Past
subtitle: The Lord of the Rings Part 1
text:
You are playing Campaign Mode.
Setup: Attach Mr. Underhill to the Ring-bearer. Add Gandalf's Delay to the staging area. Shuffle Gildor Inglorion and The Ring Draws Them into the encounter deck.
back_text: Resolution: Choose Gandalf's Delay or The Ring Draws Them and add it to the Campaign Pool. Then, choose Gildor Inglorion or Mr. Underhill and add it to the Campaign Pool. The chosen cards have been earned by the players.

name: A Knife in the Dark
subtitle: The Lord of the Rings Part 2
back_text: Resolution: Starting with the first player, each player may choose one of the following boon cards and attach it to a hero he controls: Tireless Ranger, Skilled Healer, Valiant Warrior, Noble Hero. The chosen cards have been earned by the players.

name: Flight to the Ford
subtitle: The Lord of the Rings Part 3
text:
You are playing Campaign Mode.
Response: After an enemy is declared as an attacker, shuffle the top card of the burden deck into the encounter deck to cancel that attack. (Any player may trigger this ability.)
back_text: Resolution: Add each burden card in play, in the encounter deck, and in the discard pile to the Campaign Pool. The added cards have been earned by the players.
